batch.publication: temporary full-run output verified and not committed

geography.policy: No nearest-province coercion; non-assigned rows retain null province fields.

review_fixes_verified.boundary_provenance: validated before both new publication and idempotent reuse: pinned source identity, snapshot, commit, source/canonical checksums, ODbL license, attribution, exact 38-province crosswalk, and canonical geometry
review_fixes_verified.request_identity: credential-free source URL is bound to and rechecked against an existing immutable batch
review_fixes_verified.acquisition_retries: bounded to 1-5 attempts; only transient network/timeout/HTTP 429 or 5xx/response-read errors retry; local filesystem and other HTTP 4xx errors use one attempt; exhaustion preserves prior destination and removes temporary files

limitations: The generated 241 MiB batch was created under /tmp for verification and is not a repository artifact.
D05 emits logical contract artifacts only; ClickHouse DDL, loading, grants, and serving views belong to D06.
Multiple polygon intersections remain explicit multiple_match records with null province fields.
Hotspots are satellite detections, not confirmed wildfire incidents or burned-area estimates.
